scope: r28 Windows HDR hotkey pre-Present guard. Live evidence showed Win+Alt+B changes the display output HDR domain before Control reaches ResizeBuffers, so r27 resize-side quiescing can still be too late. r28 detects the IDXGIOutput6 color-space flip at the wrapper Present boundary, queues DLSS-G off before that same real Present, holds FG off until the HDR bridge generation advances, then retains the r26 two-fresh-frame warmup. r27 resize-side quiesce remains fallback.

tests.policy_normal: PASS HDR display-domain pre-Present guard: output HDR flip holds FG off before ResizeBuffers; bridge generation handoff plus two fresh-domain frames retained
tests.policy_asan_ubsan: PASS HDR display-domain pre-Present guard: output HDR flip holds FG off before ResizeBuffers; bridge generation handoff plus two fresh-domain frames retained
tests.source_contract: PASS Present/Present1 sample IDXGIOutput6 before conversion/inner Present; Streamline pending gate and resize fallback both present

assertions: No FG disable is triggered before an output-domain baseline exists.
A real SDR<->HDR output-domain flip is detected independently of Control ResizeBuffers.
The pre-resize pending state holds FG off while the HDR bridge generation is unchanged.
Once ResizeBuffers advances the bridge generation, ownership hands to the existing two-fresh-frame warmup.
The r27 committed-Present quiesce path remains available as fallback for transitions not led by an output color-space change.
RR and the r24 compute-only HDR HUDless path are outside this change.
